biometric.title: Biometric sign-in
biometric.toggleWindows: Windows Hello (face, fingerprint or Windows PIN)
biometric.toggleHint: The password is still needed once every 7 days
biometric.off: Off. It resets when the password or the fingerprints change.
biometric.on: On. It resets when the password or the fingerprints change.
biometric.expired: Password needed: 7 days have passed. Sign in with the password the next time you open the vault.
biometric.unavailable: This system has no protected storage for the key, sign-in is by password only.
biometric.enableHint: Enter the password to bind the key to this device's biometrics.
biometric.enableFailed: Could not turn on quick sign-in
biometric.disableFailed: Could not turn off quick sign-in
biometric.failedText: The request was cancelled or not recognised. Try again or enter the password.
biometric.resetText: The password or a fingerprint changed. Sign in with the password and turn it on again in the settings.
biometric.passwordText: 7 days have passed since the last entry. After you sign in, biometrics work again.
